_comment: GLOBAL rules — apply across all levels. Movement (WASD) and goal-touch transition. Per-level rules (if any) live in levels/<name>/world_rules.json and append to these at level load.

rules._comment: === MOVEMENT — velocity_add_relative for diagonal-friendly walk; drag decelerates between inputs. Top-down 2D so facing is fixed at 0; WASD maps to world axes via velocity_add_relative's forward/strafe with facing=0 → forward=-Z, strafe-left=+X.
=== GOAL TRIGGER — when player contacts the level's goal entity, fire transition_level. once_per_a prevents double-firing on the same tick. Player.cleared increments for HUD feedback.
